families.description: A quirky, high-contrast grotesque with eccentric details, made for bold editorial headlines.
A sharp, condensed display face with idiosyncratic alternates, originally commissioned for the Murmure agency.
A soft, blobby display typeface with liquid curves and playful, organic letterforms.
A chimeric display face mixing serif, sans and blackletter structures into one shape-shifting alphabet.
A sharp, high-contrast serif with angular cuts, designed collaboratively as a libre project.
A lively serif inspired by medieval and Renaissance printing, full of ink-trap character.
A heavy, rounded geometric display face inspired by 1960s–70s Swiss and Italian lettering.
A typewriter-inspired family with a distinct personality per weight, referencing early 20th-century office type.
A micro-sized monospace with sturdy shapes, crisp at tiny sizes and expressive when blown up.
A geometric sans-serif inspired by 1920s German sans faces like Futura, tuned for modern screens and editorial layouts.
A Clarendon-style slab serif with generous curves, available in width and weight variations.
A high-contrast Didone with optical sizes, bringing fashion-magazine elegance to both text and display.
A bold geometric sans-serif based on classic early-20th-century geometric type, expanded to a full variable family.
A humanist sans-serif with open forms that balances warmth and clarity in text and UI.
A gorgeous ultra-condensed sans with long necks, plus inline, dashed and rounded variants for posters.
A faithful revival of Frederic Goudy's Goudy Oldstyle, with refined italics for book typography.
An ultra-bold slab serif with chunky Egyptian proportions — loud, friendly headline type.
Vercel's crisp Swiss-inspired sans-serif built for interfaces, dashboards and developer tooling.
The monospaced companion to Geist, designed for code, terminals and technical UI.
Part of GitHub's Monaspace superfamily: a neo-grotesque sans voice with texture healing for even, readable code.
Part of GitHub's Monaspace superfamily: a humanist sans voice with texture healing for even, readable code.
Part of GitHub's Monaspace superfamily: a slab-serif voice with texture healing for even, readable code.
An anonymous, neutral coding font with smart kerning that keeps monospaced text calm and readable.
A rounded, friendly coding font with cursive italics, ligatures and excellent CJK pairing.
A duospace-derived writing font with four widths, tuned for focused long-form writing.
iA Writer's monospace, a refinement of IBM Plex Mono for distraction-free writing.
JetBrains Mono patched with thousands of Nerd Font glyphs for powerline prompts, icons and terminals.
Fira Code's programming ligatures combined with the full Nerd Fonts icon set for terminal setups.
A clean contemporary grotesque with subtle quirks, made free for everyone by Uncut.wtf.
The expanded successor to Atkinson Hyperlegible, maximising character distinction for low-vision readers.
